dedupe_keys.name: gridded material stocks in china based on geographical and geometric configurations of the built environment

description: Gridded material stocks in China based on geographical and geometric configurations of the built-environment is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Jian Sun et al. Material stocks have created alternative perspectives in many environmental and climate studies. Their significance nonetheless may be under-explored, partially due to scarcity of more precise, timely and higher-resolution information. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2023. Formats: GeoTIFF. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 632553276 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
